verdict.rationale: Authy has a developer surface (Twilio-hosted API and SDK docs), so asking for llms.txt or agent-oriented documentation is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence mentions llms.txt, machine-readable docs, or documentation written for AI agents. The docs cited are ordinary human-facing pages, and the probe notes the Authy API is closed to new customers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
